title: Property Delivery Metrics
description: Delivery metrics for one publisher property. The stable operational key is (publisher_domain, identifier.type, identifier.value); property_ref adds catalog identity when resolution is available.

verifier_constraints.property_domain_consistency: property_ref.publisher_domain MUST equal publisher_domain when property_ref is present

publisher_domain.description: Publisher or platform authority that namespaces the operational identifier, including when the surface is not registered in adagents.json.

identifier.description: Primary operational identifier of the property that delivered. Required even when catalog enrichment is unavailable.

property_ref.description: Canonical publisher-scoped catalog identity when the delivered property resolves to adagents.json. Its publisher_domain MUST equal the row's publisher_domain.

property_name.description: Current human-readable property name. Convenience metadata only; property_ref is stable identity.
